A [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] '''agent''' was working for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], watching over the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Morbo]] as part of [[Operation Transom]]. In [[3640 BBY]], he brawled with fellow agent [[Theron Shan]], unaware of his allegiance.
